description: This file defines the Request class and related performance and JSON-RPC tracking classes within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes request state management, service association, and performance statistics tracking for request handling, as well as JSON-RPC message tracking.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/Web request, managing its state, associated service, and whether it is a service call or JSONRPC.

classes.name: PerformanceAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class for managing performance statistics related to request processing, including deserialization, thread pool, execution, communication, serialization, and total times.

classes.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Statistics
classes.description: Holds statistical data and provides methods to add data, clear statistics, and retrieve various performance metrics.

classes.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Statistics::DataSet
classes.description: Stores individual timing measurements for different phases of request processing.

classes.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Statistics::Tuple
classes.description: Aggregates timing data, providing min, max, average, and count metrics.

classes.name: TrackingJSONRPC
classes.description: Tracks JSON-RPC message statistics, including in/out data sizes and timing metrics for request processing stages.

methods.name: Request::ServiceCall
methods.description: Checks if the request was received over the service prefix path.

methods.name: Request::State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the request.

methods.name: Request::Service
methods.description: Returns a reference to the associated service proxy.

methods.name: Request::Service
methods.description: Sets the service error code, associated service, and whether it is a service call.

methods.name: PerformanceAdministrator::Statistics::Tuple::Measurement
methods.description: Updates min, max, average, and count based on new data.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::In
methods.description: Records incoming data size and timing.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::Out
methods.description: Records outgoing data size and timing.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::Acquire
methods.description: Marks the start of request processing.

methods.name: TrackingJSONRPC::Relinquish
methods.description: Records completion timing and stores statistics.
